summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported that Tom Allen sparred three friendly rounds with Morris O'Connell at O'Connell's farewell benefit at Tom Kelly's, still moving with the ease and grace of a dancing master.

metadata.notes: Masthead: 'St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Thursday Morning, February 22, 1883', page 5.

facts.fact: Allen sparred three rounds with Morris O'Connell in a friendly exhibition of skill at O'Connell's farewell benefit at Tom Kelly's, before an overflowing crowd

notes: Announced in article 686. Allen's bout was the drawing feature, so focus is primary.
